summary:
Implemented the terminal window title setting in the rich repo, by reading and editing files only. Nothing was run and nothing was committed. Changes:
- rich/segment.py: added SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 after ERASE_IN_LINE; added Tuple[ControlType, str] to the ControlCode union.
- rich/control.py: added the SET_WINDOW_TITLE format entry producing ESC ] 0 ; title BEL, and the Control.title(title) classmethod with a docstring.
- rich/console.py: added Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool beside show_cursor. It checks only is_terminal and returns False with nothing written otherwise. Google-style docstring includes the caveats.
- rich/_windows_renderer.py: added one elif branch calling term.set_title with the second item. Win32 wrapper unchanged.
- CHANGELOG.md: created an Unreleased "Added" section with a bullet linking pull request 2200.
- Tests: test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (skipped on Windows); test_control_title in tests/test_control.py; test_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows only, mocked wrapper).
Tests and mypy were not run, per the instructions; verification was by reading only. Choices: Console test skips on win32 like the other tests; title text is not validated or escaped; no imports added.
